title: Dictionary Data Type
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python solution using a dictionary to store student information and then printing out the information in the desired format:

```python
student_info = {'name': 'John Doe', 'age': 20, 'year': 'Sophomore'}

# Print out the information in the desired format
print("Name:", student_info['name'])
print("Age:", student_info['age'])
print("Year:", student_info['year'])

# Alternatively, you can use f-strings for a more concise and readable output
print(f"Name: {student_info['name']}, Age: {student_info['age']}, Year: {student_info['year']}")
```

When you run this code, it will output:

```
Name: John Doe
Age: 20
Year: Sophomore
Name: John Doe, Age: 20, Year: Sophomore
```

You can replace the sample input dictionary with your own dictionary to store student information, and modify the print statements to print out the information in any format you prefer.
